# Muhammad Hamza — Software Engineer & AI Developer

> Canonical Identity: Muhammad Hamza (Peshawar, Pakistan) — Software Engineer, AI Developer, and Creator of Quizior.

Muhammad Hamza is a Software Engineer and AI Developer based in Peshawar, Pakistan. He is the Main Developer of Quizior (https://quizior.live), Co-Founder of Solvia Codes, and Co-Lead of Nexior.
